notes.title: Long-poll, not a pipeline step
notes.text: The MCP wait tool long-polls GET /api/wait on its own schedule (timeout clamped to 1s–600s, default 120s). The save doesn't trigger it.

notes.title: Files mode when no daemon
notes.text: With no daemon, MCP writes .vibeprint/ directly under runtime/files.lock. After 5s of waiting it fails with 503 'Another process is writing'. Locks older than 10s are removed.

notes.title: Corrupt canvas fails closed
notes.text: If .vibeprint/canvas.json won't parse (e.g. merge conflicts) or isn't a Vibeprint canvas, the daemon throws and asks you to restore it from git. It does not overwrite it.
